About BOBBY AC Repair & Services

A local AC and home appliance service provider in Narasaraopet.

Who we are

BOBBY AC REPAIR & SERVICES is a local service provider based in Narasaraopet, Andhra Pradesh. Our main work is AC repair, servicing, installation, uninstallation and gas filling for split and window ACs.

We also repair refrigerators, washing machines, air coolers and ceiling fans, so families can call one trusted local number for most home appliance problems.

How we work

  • Inspect first. We find the actual cause before suggesting any repair or part.
  • Explain clearly. You hear what is wrong in simple words.
  • Estimate before work. Nothing starts until you agree to the cost.
  • Test before we leave. We check the appliance is working after the job.
